Come with me to the press preview of cats the jellicle ball, one of my favorite off broadway shows from last year that is finally coming to broadway this spring. Cats the jellicle ball reimagines the musical cats and turns it into a full on ballroom competition, with each fierce performer presenting their own category, style, and identity on the runway. The second I walked into the room, I was reminded exactly why I loved it. The choreography is electric and the energy is unmatched. And after the performance, I got to interview members of the cast and the creative team. It's a ball, baby, so get ready.
